crossRefs.note: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out…
The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is…
He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
translations.bsb: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
translations.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
translations.asv: Now Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus oft-times resorted thither with his disciples.
